in_marathi.name: Iyush
in_marathi.long_meaning: Iyush हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Iyush is a Sanskrit name derived from the word 'Iyusha' which means 'joy' or 'delight'. In Hindu mythology, Lord Vishnu is often referred to as Ishvara Iyusha, the lord who brings joy and delight to his devotees. The name Iyush is a reflection of this divine trait, and is often given to boys as a symbol of happiness and joy.
